name: Innovex Mixer Grinder IMG013
description: Powerful 550W Innovex mixer grinder with 3 stainless steel jars. Ideal for wet grinding, dry grinding and chutney preparation.
details: The Innovex IMG013 Mixer Grinder comes with a complete stainless steel jar set including 1.5L wet jar, 1.0L dry jar and 0.3L chutney jar. It features a powerful fully copper motor, highly efficient blades and BS plug. Suitable for daily kitchen use in Sri Lankan homes. Easy to operate and clean.
